clockIntegrity.disposition: A three-hour host wall-clock jump occurred during CopperStart. Monotonic sampling and native frame progress continued; elapsed duration uses QPC, not UTC subtraction.

firstPreflight.disposition: Observer visibility/pause/fault guard triggered after about 55 seconds; the initial report did not distinguish which condition. The observer then closed normally. User denied closing or pausing. No CLR/native fault found in its log or matching Windows events. Cause unresolved; not relabeled or claimed fixed.

dashboardCorrection.disposition: Captured sharing failure in auxiliary dashboard replacement caused diagnostic cleanup. Best-effort dashboard fixes that observer defect; raw samples remain authoritative. The unchanged locked-file control fails against 1.1.29.0 and passes against the corrected writer. Failed preflight retained.

limitations: Provisional current-PC observations only; no frozen release budgets, minimum/reference hardware or throughput acceptance.
